Command to be executed.
Value: unsubscribe

Subscription ID entered in AMPS by the client when the original
subscription was placed.
AMPS accepts a single subscription ID or a comma-delimited list of
subscription ID.
The keyword all can also be used to unsubscribe from all current
subscriptions for the client.
When both SubId and QueryId are provided, AMPS removes all
matching subscriptions and SOW queries.
This command requires at least one of the SubId or QueryId fields to be
set.
